title: The Normanist Controversy
question: To what extent was the Rus' polity founded by Scandinavian (Varangian) elites?

positions.label: Traditional Normanist Position
positions.summary: Scandinavian warrior-traders played a decisive role in organizing the first East Slavic polities.

positions.label: Anti-Normanist / Indigenous Emphasis
positions.summary: Local East Slavic populations drove the fundamental development, with Scandinavians playing a secondary role.

resolutionNotes: Current consensus accepts significant Scandinavian participation while emphasizing rapid Slavicization of the elite.
